manual.enUS: First stack the Trag'Oul four-piece Life bonus to 300%, then summon the permanent Blood and Bone Simulacrums.

app.50146da16a1fe7ce.template: 分身继承召唤时的生命状态；跳过预热会同时损失伤害和坚韧。

manual.enUS: The Simulacrums inherit your Life state when summoned; skipping the setup costs both damage and toughness.

app.0578f4a56524c583.source: 用鲜血穿行触发斯图亚特，跳过零散小怪，只在精英与密集怪群停留。

manual.enUS: Trigger Steuart's Greaves with Blood Rush, skip scattered trash, and stop only for elites and dense packs.

app.c8a75a57ca7c1fc3.template: [[NephalemRift/TieredRift]]没有金币链，移动效率来自位移后的10秒提速。

manual.enUS: Greater Rifts have no gold chain; mobility comes from the 10-second speed boost after teleporting.
Open the damage window with Bone Armor

app.1a77046ca163291a.source: 贴近怪群叠满骨甲，并在全能法戒物理周期用白骨脱臼触发强控。
app.1a77046ca163291a.template: 贴近怪群叠满[[Powers/P6_Necro_BoneArmor_name]]，并在[[Items/P2_Unique_Ring_04]]物理周期用[[AttributeDescriptions/NameRune_C#P6_Necro_BoneArmor]]触发[[Site/crowd-control]]。

manual.enUS: Stack Bone Armor in melee range, then use Dislocation for hard crowd control during Convention of Elements' Physical cycle.

app.ca97112167315bc9.source: 这套仍保留冲层的全能法戒与克里斯宾爆发窗。

manual.enUS: This setup retains the push build's Convention of Elements and Krysbin burst window.

manual.enUS: Channel Siphon Blood into dense packs so Iron Rose and the Simulacrums cast Blood Nova.

app.eba20531c1fb6e82.source: 强者之灾替代受罚者，目标是快速处理精英而非长时间首领战。
app.eba20531c1fb6e82.template: [[Items/Unique_Gem_001_x1]]替代[[Items/Unique_Gem_018_x1]]，目标是快速处理精英而非长时间首领战。

manual.enUS: Bane of the Powerful replaces Stricken to kill elites quickly instead of supporting a long Rift Guardian fight.
Lower the tier when the boss takes too long

app.a827834ee35bf991.source: 若秘境守卫超过1–2个物理周期仍未击杀，降低层数或改用冲层配置。
app.a827834ee35bf991.template: 若秘境守卫超过1–2个物理周期仍未击杀，降低层数或改用[[Site/push]]配置。

manual.enUS: If the Rift Guardian survives more than one or two Physical cycles, lower the tier or switch to the push setup.

manual.enUS: Two current Season 39 sources agree on Aughild shoulders and bracers, Dayntee's Binding, and Mantle of Channeling in the cube for pushing; Switch controls remain untested.

app.2c2423c2c9424e95.source: 移除装备上的多余智力

app.8b0efed222a606ad.source: Icy Veins 明确把守护者作为成长早期的 GR 速刷方案；保留全能法戒，用斯图亚特和强者之灾换取稳定转场与精英效率。
app.8b0efed222a606ad.template: Icy Veins 明确把[[Powers/Templar_CheatDeath_Passive_name]]作为成长早期的 GR [[Site/speed-farming]]方案；保留[[Items/P2_Unique_Ring_04]]，用斯图亚特和[[Items/Unique_Gem_001_x1]]换取稳定转场与精英效率。

manual.enUS: Icy Veins explicitly uses Guardian's for early-progression Greater Rift speed farming; keep Convention of Elements and use Steuart's Greaves plus Bane of the Powerful for traversal and elite efficiency.

app.ae0d9b3cc93a56f5.source: 约 2000 巅峰且不再依赖守护者时，换奥吉德与戴恩提；斯图亚特、强者之灾和较低目标层级负责缩短单次用时。
app.ae0d9b3cc93a56f5.template: 约 2000 [[Site/paragon]]且不再依赖[[Powers/Templar_CheatDeath_Passive_name]]时，换[[ItemSets/P66_Crafted Nightmare Set 002]]与[[Items/P61_Unique_Belt_01]]；斯图亚特、[[Items/Unique_Gem_001_x1]]和较低目标层级负责缩短单次用时。

manual.enUS: Around Paragon 2000, once Guardian's is no longer needed, switch to Aughild's and Dayntee's; Steuart's, Bane of the Powerful, and a lower target tier reduce clear times.

app.6e1a01f0f1fd89a8.source: Icy Veins 的默认 T16 技能栏与 S39 第四槽说明存在组合歧义，d3guides.de 又给出不同的技能变化；配置保留供研究，不作为推荐。
app.6e1a01f0f1fd89a8.template: Icy Veins 的默认 T16 技能栏与 S39 第四槽说明存在组合歧义，d3guides.de 又给出不同的技能变化；配置保留供研究，不作为推荐。

manual.enUS: Icy Veins' default T16 skill bar conflicts with its Season 39 fourth-slot explanation, while d3guides.de lists different skill changes; this setup is retained for research and is not recommended.

app.8235d5047cea33a1.source: Icy Veins 支持单人金织带、沃兹克和随从贪婪之戒，但与 d3guides.de 的 T16 变体不一致；完成 Switch 实测前不作为推荐。
app.8235d5047cea33a1.template: Icy Veins 支持[[Site/solo]][[Items/Unique_Belt_010_x1]]、[[Items/Unique_Bracer_101_x1]]和随从[[Items/Unique_Ring_108_x1]]，但与 d3guides.de 的 T16 变体不一致；完成 Switch 实测前不作为推荐。

manual.enUS: Icy Veins supports solo Goldwrap, Warzechian Armguards, and Avarice Band on the follower, but this differs from the d3guides.de T16 variant; it is not recommended before Switch testing.

app.f8c90e3970f11250.source: 金币链启动前避免硬站
app.f8c90e3970f11250.template: 金币链启动前避免硬站

app.778ff0a74ce05ee0.source: S39 冲层骨架为五件塔格奥、奥吉德肩腕、戴恩提、鬼灵面容、克里斯宾、全能法戒、葬镰与铁玫瑰。
app.778ff0a74ce05ee0.template: S39 [[Site/push]]骨架为五件[[ItemSets/P6_Necro_Set_2]]、[[ItemSets/P66_Crafted Nightmare Set 002]]肩腕、[[Items/P61_Unique_Belt_01]]、[[Items/P69_Unique_Amulet_02]]、[[Items/P6_Unique_Ring_03]]、[[Items/P2_Unique_Ring_04]]、[[Items/P74_Unique_Scythe1H_01]]与[[Items/P74_Unique_Phylactery_04]]。

manual.enUS: The Season 39 push core uses five Trag'Oul pieces, Aughild shoulders and bracers, Dayntee's Binding, Haunted Visions, Krysbin's Sentence, Convention of Elements, Funerary Pick, and Iron Rose.

app.a7642f931d5e7927.source: Icy Veins 的鲜血新星/白骨脱臼/脆弱光环/鲜血与白骨与 d3guides.de 当前符文表不一致。
app.a7642f931d5e7927.template: Icy Veins 的[[AttributeDescriptions/NameRune_C#P6_Necro_BloodNova]]/[[AttributeDescriptions/NameRune_C#P6_Necro_BoneArmor]]/[[AttributeDescriptions/NameRune_E#P6_Necro_Frailty]]/[[AttributeDescriptions/NameRune_D#P6_Necro_Simulacrum]]与 d3guides.de 当前符文表不一致。

manual.enUS: Icy Veins' Blood Nova, Dislocation, Frailty aura, and Blood and Bone setup differs from the current d3guides.de skill table.

app.d2c90a053c969eaf.source: 两站的装备发动机一致，但多个技能符文不同；在游戏内逐项复核前不能把技能栏标为交叉核对。
app.d2c90a053c969eaf.template: 两站的装备发动机一致，但多个技能符文不同；在游戏内逐项复核前不能把技能栏标为交叉核对。

manual.enUS: The two sites agree on the gear engine but differ on several skill runes; the skill bar cannot be marked cross-checked until each entry is verified in game.

app.a8e3165d7ee607d7.source: 冲层魔方为血潮利刃、导能披肩、皇家华戒与 S39 轮回镰刀。

manual.enUS: The push cube uses Bloodtide Blade, Mantle of Channeling, Ring of Royal Grandeur, and Scythe of the Cycle in Season 39.

app.eea0410880faeac9.source: 冲层传奇宝石为困者、贼神和受罚者。

manual.enUS: The push legendary gems are Bane of the Trapped, Zei's Stone of Vengeance, and Bane of the Stricken.

app.f25a8310e7ba7ecb.source: 80–90 万生命、1.67 攻速和 120% 以上范围伤是 Icy Veins 给出的冲层检查点。
app.f25a8310e7ba7ecb.template: 80–90 万生命、1.67 攻速和 120% 以上范围伤是 Icy Veins 给出的[[Site/push]]检查点。

manual.enUS: Icy Veins lists 800,000–900,000 Life, 1.67 attacks per second, and at least 120% Area Damage as push checkpoints.

app.42ddfc13216e369a.source: 塔格奥死亡新星存在独立 GR 速刷用途，但资料只称其表现合理，不能外推为同职业最快。
app.42ddfc13216e369a.template: [[ItemSets/P6_Necro_Set_2]][[Powers/P6_Necro_BloodNova_name]]存在独立 GR [[Site/speed-farming]]用途，但资料只称其表现合理，不能外推为同职业最快。

manual.enUS: Trag'Oul Death Nova has a separate Greater Rift speed-farming use, but the sources only call it reasonably effective and do not establish it as the class's fastest option.

app.a779e25da62fc635.source: GR 速刷保留全能法戒，防具萃取改斯图亚特，受罚者改强者；守护者转奥吉德只由 Icy Veins 明确给出。
app.a779e25da62fc635.template: GR [[Site/speed-farming]]保留[[Items/P2_Unique_Ring_04]]，防具萃取改斯图亚特，[[Items/Unique_Gem_018_x1]]改强者；[[Powers/Templar_CheatDeath_Passive_name]]转[[ItemSets/P66_Crafted Nightmare Set 002]]只由 Icy Veins 明确给出。

manual.enUS: Greater Rift speed farming keeps Convention of Elements, cubes Steuart's Greaves, and replaces Stricken with Powerful; only Icy Veins explicitly describes switching from Guardian's to Aughild's.

app.c9fd7a992cff7360.source: 两站都支持斯图亚特与强者，但只有 Icy Veins 描述约 2000 巅峰的守护者转奥吉德条件。
app.c9fd7a992cff7360.template: 两站都支持斯图亚特与强者，但只有 Icy Veins 描述约 2000 [[Site/paragon]]的[[Powers/Templar_CheatDeath_Passive_name]]转[[ItemSets/P66_Crafted Nightmare Set 002]]条件。

manual.enUS: Both sites support Steuart's Greaves and Bane of the Powerful, but only Icy Veins describes the Guardian-to-Aughild's switch near Paragon 2000.

app.3d5f89d0a286dcb0.source: 两站都列出 T16 变体，但技能、戒指与金币链的具体配置没有一致到可发布程度。
app.3d5f89d0a286dcb0.template: 两站都列出 T16 变体，但技能、戒指与金币链的具体配置没有一致到可发布程度。

manual.enUS: Both sites list a T16 variant, but their skill, ring, and gold-chain details do not agree well enough for publication.

app.eb8f4a3860e04943.source: Icy Veins 的默认 T16 技能栏使用吞噬/死亡之力，同时 S39 第四槽段落要求骨甲/轮回镰刀；d3guides.de 又只声明符文、斯图亚特和宝石变化。
app.eb8f4a3860e04943.template: Icy Veins 的默认 T16 技能栏使用[[Powers/P6_Necro_Devour_name]]/[[Powers/P6_Necro_Passive_CorpseConsumptionIncreasesMovementSpeed_name]]，同时 S39 第四槽段落要求[[Powers/P6_Necro_BoneArmor_name]]/[[Items/P61_Unique_Scythe1H_03]]；d3guides.de 又只声明符文、斯图亚特和宝石变化。

manual.enUS: Icy Veins' default T16 skill bar uses Devour and Fueled by Death, while its Season 39 fourth-slot section requires Bone Armor and Scythe of the Cycle; d3guides.de only specifies rune, Steuart's, and gem changes.

app.58e3d17bcc8cc75b.source: T16 用困者、囤宝者和强者，不把囤宝者带进 GR。

manual.enUS: For T16 [[General/LootRunPortal]], blue portals and bounties, combine [[Items/Unique_Belt_010_x1]], [[Items/Unique_Gem_014_x1]] and [[Items/Unique_Ring_108_x1]] for the gold setup, with [[Items/Unique_Ring_104_x1]] and [[Items/Unique_Sword_1H_113_x1]] to minimize travel time and cooldowns. Once damage is sufficient, prioritize movement speed, cooldown reduction and pickup radius in gems and affixes. At high Paragon, consider [[Items/Unique_Ring_010_x1]] for survivability when approaching tier 110.
